name: Health
definition: Health GovTech includes patient records, provider credentialing, health supply chains, and interoperability across clinics, labs, insurers, and public health authorities.
summary: Health data and supply chain with privacy.
challenges: Health data is sensitive and siloed; provider credentialing and supply-chain verification are fragmented across jurisdictions.
opportunities: VCs for provider credentials and attestations for supply-chain integrity can improve verification; privacy-preserving tech can support safe data sharing.

experiments.title: HL7 FHIR + verifiable credentials
experiments.description: Healthcare interoperability with provider credential verification.
